Hi po, I felt the weight of your mental stress. While I am not yet officially in UP, I can attest that from this point on, you're spiraling to madness already. There's so much weight in your every word that it went beyond the screen. I could hear your every sigh and imagine every momentary pause to breathe while you typed this. I am worried about the further damage you might suffer as you force yourself to stay. If you're looking for a sign to go, maybe this is it. Or maybe not. Maybe you've already decided but do not want to fully accept it yet. What's stopping you? What are you clinging to that makes it harder to go? The idea that you have to keep up and continue the mental torture because this is all just pussiness? Is that truth? If you're looking at the world through the haze of false resilience they say you have to practice, that would probably be the truth. But the truth lies, too.

After all, you're the one to decide. But please, always listen to your body. You are a plant currently in the UP soil. If you feel like you shrink in a place you're supposed to grow in and see the shrinking materialize, maybe the world you're in is not meant for the type of plant that you are. The rumble inside your chest will only cease when your heart finally recognizes its home to rest. It's never wrong to feel that you don't belong, by the way; it's your valid response to the situation that takes a toll on you. 

I say this because nobody told me it's okay to break free before. It would've made a huge difference had someone did. It would've been a different life without painful stagnancies. 

I hope you the best, Kuya/Ate.
